Cite evidence of commitment without requiring a scripted confirmation order. Check that continuations agree with the current plan across DMs, group chats and email; an old week's venue is not the current venue unless someone changes it. Quoted email history is historical context, not a new confirmation. `Me` consistently represents the user. Judge meaning, not token overlap. Return only JSON with keys supported (boolean), evidence (array of numbered dialogue line integers), and problem (short explanation, empty when supported).

Conversation date: 2026-10-05. Resolve relative dates from this fictional date.
The new messages will be timestamped between 10:00 and 10:20 local time. Reject dialogue that clearly places the current exchange at a different time of day.

Include `facts`, an array with one object per numbered fact: index (1-based integer), supported (boolean), evidence (array of line integers), problem (short string). Reject the scene if any fact is absent or contradicted.
